description: Source code for FreeType outline management, including functions for decomposing, creating, copying, transforming, and rendering font outlines.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Decompose
methods.description: Decomposes an outline into its constituent parts using callback functions.

methods.name: FT_Outline_New_Internal
methods.description: Initializes a new outline with specified points and contours.

methods.name: FT_Outline_New
methods.description: Creates a new outline object within a library context.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Check
methods.description: Validates the integrity of an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Copy
methods.description: Copies outline data from source to target.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Done_Internal
methods.description: Frees resources associated with an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Done
methods.description: Frees resources of an outline within a library context.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_CBox
methods.description: Calculates the bounding box of an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Translate
methods.description: Translates (moves) an outline by given offsets.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Reverse
methods.description: Reverses the point order in an outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Render
methods.description: Renders an outline using a specified rasterizer.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_Bitmap
methods.description: Converts an outline to a bitmap.

methods.name: FT_Vector_Transform
methods.description: Applies a transformation matrix to a vector.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Transform
methods.description: Transforms all points in an outline with a matrix.

methods.name: FT_Outline_EmboldenXY
methods.description: Embosses an outline with specified x and y strengths.

methods.name: FT_Outline_Get_Orientation
methods.description: Determines the orientation (clockwise or counterclockwise) of an outline.
